info.name: FinCard BFF - Virtual_Card_API_Test_Tenant
info.description:
Complete API collection for the FinCard Virtual Card BFF.

Base path: /api/v2.1/fincard/virtual

**Quick Start:**
1. Import the companion environment file `FinCard-BFF.postman_environment.json`
2. Run **🔐 Auth / Login** — bearerToken is auto-saved
3. Run **💰 Account / Create Shared Account** — accountId is auto-saved
4. Run **👤 Card Holder / Create Cardholder V2** — holderId is auto-saved
5. Run **💳 Card / Create Card V2** — cardId is auto-saved

All subsequent requests use those saved variables automatically.
